items.caption:
The longtime MADtv cast member and precision impressionist is back on the stand-up circuit.
Aries Spears performs at Smart Financial Centre at Sugar Land on January 29, 2027. He is known for impressions including Shaquille O'Neal and Denzel Washington. Tickets on sale now. Link in bio.
